title: Session-specific cooldowns (tests unchanged)
what: training.yaml cooldowns cool_lower (3 min easy + breathing + dead hangs), cool_upper (3 min easy + child's pose breathing, no hangs), cool_hard (5-8 min easy to HR < ~110 + breathing; metcon/Hyrox/quality runs/threshold), cool_easy (3-5 min walk; easy runs, long run, bike). Templates point at the matching one; test days keep standard.
why: Athlete asked for cooldowns tailored like the warm-ups. Cooldowns don't speed recovery, so they stay short: gradual HR drop after hard work, a brief down-regulation, no hangs after pulling (front-of-shoulder watch); mobility lives in the evening routine.

history.note: athlete said yes in chat; awaiting coach approve by the athlete
